name: Bull Poker
summary: A seven-card stud variant where three hole cards are ordered then gradually revealed after four upcards.
rules_text: Bull Poker uses a 52-card deck. Each player is dealt three cards face down and must order them from first to last to be revealed; the order cannot change. There is a betting round. Then four cards are dealt face up to each player one at a time, with a betting round after each upcard. After the upcards, each player flips their first down card face up, betting round, then flips their second down card face up, betting round, then flips the final down card. Players form the best five-card poker hand from their seven cards using standard rankings. The best hand wins the pot. Betting is pot-based with folding allowed.
rating_reason: Poker variant with bidding, bluffing, hidden hands.
